blocking_drift.title: Deployed client world manifest is still pinned to V5
blocking_drift.detail: src/generated/world-manifest.ts declares SPAWN_SET_VERSION "v5" and WORLD_SPAWN_HASH 48680a9dbd5e045d7bb4709ac64ce83e8466fd852acd091710836919a65d2743, while production reports the V6 spawn hash 69a4276f9466c02eef28ff8b8d93804e9d103504c163c1e1aa630dd9aba0c163. src/game/world-runtime.ts resolveWorldRuntime() compares that constant with the server spawn hash and falls back to maintenance mode on mismatch, so the deployed V6 client cannot enter the uuid_v2 world path.
blocking_drift.root_cause: scripts/v6/build.mjs only writes src/generated/world-manifest.ts under --promote, and the V6 rollout promoted only src/generated/content-manifest.ts.
blocking_drift.remedy_requires_owner_approval: run scripts/v6/build.mjs --promote (world manifest only), verify, and republish the client; no database change is required
blocking_drift.v7_prevention: the V7 client identity gate must assert content manifest, world manifest, release catalogue, content catalogue and all three migrations agree on version and hash, and must fail the production build otherwise
